items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer asks Cozy Cole to tell a story about Snake Hips Tucker, but the transcript provided only shows the Interviewer narrating a story told by Barney Bigard. Cozy Cole does not speak in this segment.

ctx.x: Tell you what, let's go back about 20 years before that and pick up. Before we even do--I was going to ask you about Frankie Newton, but while we were taking a break, you mentioned about Snake Hips Tucker. Would you mind putting that on tape, it's a nice story.
